titleEn: What Does a Renovation Quote Actually Include? A Vancouver Contractor Breakdown for 2026
titleZh: 裝修報價單到底包含什麼？2026年溫哥華承包商詳細解讀
contentEn:
When Reno Stars visits a Vancouver home for a free estimate, the first question homeowners ask is rarely about timeline or design — it is almost always about price, and specifically what a quote actually covers. A line-item renovation quote done right protects both the homeowner and the contractor. Here is what a complete renovation quote from Reno Stars includes in 2026.

What Is Included in a Renovation Quote?

A professional renovation quote for a Vancouver home covers four cost categories: materials, labour, permits and fees, and contingency. Materials cover every surface finish, fixture, cabinetry, countertop, flooring and hardware specified in the design. Labour covers the skilled trades — demolition, framing, electrical, plumbing, tiling, drywall, painting and finishing. Permits and municipal fees cover any building permits required by the City of Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Surrey or other Metro Vancouver municipalities. A contingency, typically 10-15% of the total, covers unexpected conditions discovered during demolition.

What Is NOT Included in a Standard Quote?

Certain items fall outside a standard renovation quote unless specifically agreed upon. Furniture, appliances and window treatments are typically owner-supplied. Work performed by specialist trades outside the contractor scope — such as custom millwork from a separate cabinet maker or HVAC modifications by a licensed gas-fitter — may appear as a separate invoice. Work required to remediate pre-existing structural issues, mould or asbestos discovered after demolition is treated as a change order and charged separately. Reno Stars always communicates these discoveries to the homeowner before proceeding.

How to Read a Line-Item Renovation Quote

A transparent renovation quote breaks each room or phase into individual cost lines. Reno Stars structures quotes as: demolition, rough-in (electrical and plumbing), framing and drywall, tiling and grouting, finish carpentry and hardware installation, and a final walk-through and punch list. Each phase has a start date, a duration estimate and a completion criterion.

Why Do Three Quotes Come Back With Different Numbers?

Three contractor quotes for the same Vancouver renovation can differ by 20-40% and all be legitimate. The most common reasons are scope definition — one contractor may include countertop installation while another prices it as owner-supplied — and trade markup. Some contractors mark up every sub-trade invoice by 15-20%; Reno Stars operates on an open-book basis, marking up actual sub-trade costs by a fixed percentage agreed in the contract.

How Reno Stars Builds Its Quotes

Reno Stars provides fixed-price quotes for clearly defined scopes and time-and-materials pricing for open-scope projects. The quote includes a detailed scope of work document, a finish schedule with named products and model numbers, a project timeline in calendar weeks and a payment schedule tied to project milestones. The contract clearly states what triggers a change order and requires written homeowner approval before extra costs are incurred.

Planning a renovation in Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey or across Metro Vancouver? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars. Reno Stars serves homeowners in English, Mandarin and Cantonese.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does a renovation quote include GST?

Goods and Services Tax (GST) at 5% applies to all renovation services in BC. Reno Stars quotes exclude GST and add it as a separate line item so homeowners see the pre-tax price and the exact tax amount clearly.

Can I supply my own materials to lower the cost?

Yes, many homeowners in Vancouver choose to supply their own tile, fixtures or hardware. Reno Stars accommodates owner-supplied materials with a written agreement specifying delivery timelines and condition upon delivery. Delays caused by late owner-supplied materials may result in additional labour charges.

What is a contingency in a renovation quote?

A contingency is a budget set aside for unforeseen conditions discovered during demolition or construction — such as water damage hidden behind walls or outdated electrical wiring not visible before walls are opened. Reno Stars recommends a 10% contingency for older Vancouver homes (pre-1980) and 5-10% for newer construction. Unused contingency is returned to the homeowner.

How long is a renovation quote valid?

Reno Stars quotes are valid for 30 days from the date of issue. Material prices and trade labour rates can fluctuate, particularly for custom cabinetry and imported tile, so quotes older than 30 days are reviewed before a contract is signed.

What happens if I accept a quote but the scope changes?

Any scope change — adding a cabinet, upgrading a countertop material, modifying a wall location — triggers a written change order from Reno Stars stating the cost addition or credit and the impact on timeline. No extra work begins until the homeowner signs the change order.

Is a deposit required to book a Reno Stars project?

Reno Stars requires a 15% deposit at contract signing to secure materials procurement and schedule slot. Subsequent payments are milestone-based: 30% at rough-in completion, 30% at lock-up and 25% at final walk-through. This structure aligns payment with work completed.

Ready to compare renovation quotes the right way? Contact Reno Stars for a free, detailed estimate for your kitchen, bathroom or whole-home renovation in Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey or any Metro Vancouver city. Quotes are itemised, transparent and valid for 30 days.

溫哥華裝修公司聚星裝修每次上門提供免費估價時，業主問的第一個問題很少是工期或設計，而是價格——更具體地說，是報價單到底包含什麼。一份條目清晰的裝修報價單，能同時保障業主和承包商。以下是聚星裝修2026年溫哥華項目的完整報價內容。

裝修報價包含哪些內容？

一份專業的溫哥華住宅裝修報價涵蓋四類成本：材料、人工、許可證費用和應急預備金。材料涵蓋設計中指定的每一項表面飾材，固定裝置、櫃體、檯面、地板和五金。人工涵蓋各項熟練工種——拆除、主體結構、水電、瓷磚、石膏板、牆面油漆及最後收尾。許可證和市政府費用涵蓋溫哥華、列治文、本拿比、素里或其他大溫地區所需的各類建築許可證。應急預備金通常為總價的10%至15%，用於支付拆除過程中發現的意外情況。

標準報價通常不包含什麼？

以下項目除非另行書面約定，否則不在標準裝修報價範圍內：家具、電器和窗簾通常由業主自購。承包商核心範圍之外的專業工種——例如另行找木工訂製的櫃體或由持牌天然氣技師進行的暖通修改——可能以獨立發票呈現。拆除後發現的原有結構問題、黴菌或石棉等修復工作，屬於追加訂單，另行收費。聚星裝修在進行任何追加工作前，始終會與業主充分溝通。

如何閱讀條目式裝修報價單

透明的裝修報價將每個房間或階段細分為獨立成本行。聚星裝修的報價結構為：拆除、水電粗裝、主體結構和石膏板、瓷磚和填縫、成品木工和五金安裝，以及最後驗收和整改清單。每個階段均有開工日期、工期估算和完成標準。這種結構讓業主清楚了解每個階段支付的確切費用，而非收到一個簡單的總價數字。

為什麼三份報價的數字會不同？

同一溫哥華裝修項目，三份承包商報價可能相差20%至40%，但全部合理合規。最常見的價格差異原因包括：範圍定義不同——某承包商可能將檯面安裝包含在內，而另一家則將其列為業主自購；以及人工加價方式差異。部分承包商對每張分包發票加價15%至20%；聚星裝修則採用透明公開的報價模式，以雙方在合同中約定的固定百分比加價。

聚星裝修如何製定報價

聚星裝修對範圍明確的項目提供固定價格報價，對範圍待定的項目採用時間材料和實際成本報價。報價包含詳細的工程範圍說明文件、附有具體產品名稱和型號的Finish Schedule、工程工期日曆以及與項目里程碑掛鉤的付款時間表。合同明確說明觸發追加訂單的條件，並要求業主在產生額外費用前書面批准。

想在溫哥華、本拿比、列治文、素里或整個大溫地區規劃裝修？立即聯絡聚星裝修，獲取免費、無義務的估價。聚星裝修以英語、普通話和粵語為業主服務。

分包商加價公開透明，雙方約定百分比在發票基礎上加價15-20%

常見問題

裝修報價包含GST嗎？

BC省的GST（商品服務稅）為5%，適用於所有裝修服務。聚星裝修的報價不含GST，另行列出稅項，讓業主清楚看到稅前價格和準確稅額。

我可以自購材料以降低成本嗎？

可以，許多溫哥華業主選擇自行採購瓷磚、固定裝置或五金。聚星裝修接受業主自購材料，但需簽訂書面協議，訂明交貨時間和收貨時的狀態標準。若因業主自購材料延遲交付而影響工程進度，可能產生額外人工費用。

裝修報價中的應急預備金是什麼？

應急預備金是為拆除或施工過程中發現的意外情況而設的預算——例如牆後隱藏的水損、不平整的地基或拆除前無法看見的舊電線。聚星裝修建議1980年前建的溫哥華老房子預留10%應急金，新建築預留5%至10%。應急金的使用全程透明，任何未動用的款項退還給業主。

裝修報價的有效期是多長？

聚星裝修的報價自開具之日起30天內有效。材料價格和工匠工資可能波動，特別是訂製櫃體和進口瓷磚，因此超過30天的報價在簽約前會進行審核和更新。

如果我接受了報價但範圍發生變化，會怎樣？

任何範圍變更——如增加一個櫃體、升級檯面材料或移動牆面位置——都會由聚星裝修發出書面追加訂單。追加訂單列明增加或抵減的費用、對工期的影響以及修訂後的完工日期。在業主簽署追加訂單之前，不會開始任何追加工作。

預約聚星裝修項目需要定金嗎？

聚星裝修要求在簽約時支付15%定金，以確保材料採購和工期檔期。此後按里程碑階段付款：粗裝完成時付30%、封頂時付30%、最後驗收時付25%。這種結構將付款與已完成工程掛鉤，保護業主避免為尚未完成的工作付款。

準備好以正確的方式比較裝修報價了嗎？聯絡聚星裝修，獲取廚房、浴室或全屋裝修的免費詳細估價，服務覆蓋溫哥華、本拿比、列治文、素里及大溫任何城市。報價條目清晰、公開透明，有效期30天。
